label: Triage support tickets offline with Qwen3 on Ollama
description: Classifies a support ticket with Qwen3 8B running locally in Ollama, so the ticket text never leaves your network. A JSON schema constrains the answer to a category (Billing, Technical or Sales), a priority (Low, Medium or High) and a one-sentence summary that later steps can route on.

triggers.label: Manual
triggers.description: Starts the workflow when you click Run. Paste the support ticket text into the Ticket input.
triggers.name: trigger_1

tasks.label: Classify ticket
tasks.description: Classifies the ticket with Qwen3 8B running in your own Ollama, so the text never leaves your network. A JSON schema limits the answer to a category (Billing, Technical or Sales), a priority (Low, Medium or High) and a one-sentence summary.
tasks.name: ollama_1

parameters.systemPrompt: You triage customer support tickets. Pick the category and priority, and write a one-sentence summary.
